title: What is Life All About?
document_summary: Rashad argues that the soul is the real person and that bodily life should serve its development. He presents daily contact with God, fasting, and prescribed religious practice as nourishment for the soul, connects spiritual development with happiness in this world and rank in eternal life, and appeals to a mathematically coded message as tangible evidence.

You ask the average person "who are you?" and they will look in the mirror and they will say "this is me." And they are wrong. When you look in the mirror, you do not see your "self", you see your body. And your body is simply a garment that you are wearing for fifty or a hundred years. Then, you shed it. You know, it's a matter of common sense. There is a difference between a living body and a dead body. The living body is full of vitality and spark, and when it dies, the spark is gone and becomes stiff just like a piece of wood. And we know that something is gone. The person is gone. So, we can easily agree that a person consists of a body and a soul. And the soul is the real person. And this is where the people fail to recognize who they are. If they knew that the body is not them, they will rearrange their priorities, and they will pay more attention to themselves, their selves, not their bodies. Needless to say, there is a lot of detail that anyone can come and see me, and talk about it and discuss it. They can demand the proof. "Where is the physical evidence, the concrete tangible evidence you're talking about?" They can come and ask me that. And I will show it to them. And then they can make their decision themselves. They have got nothing to lose. And this is all free. I never ask him for a penny. So, they can come and see me in Tucson at 739 East 6th Street, or better yet call and make an appointment and I will sit with them and show them the proof. The telephone number should be shown at the end of this program. It is 791-3989. And it could be the most important step they have made in their life. And it results from the realization that we are not just walking zombies. We're not just bodies walking around with nothing in them.
